Markets.title: US stocks: US market rises as yields ease, Moderna lifts healthcare stocks
Markets.summary: US stock markets rose as bond yields eased and the Treasury announced liquidity support. Moderna shares surged, helping lift healthcare and broader tech stocks despite Federal Reserve inflation concerns.

Markets.title: Inflation concerns rose at US Fed's July meeting, minutes show; policymakers insisted on rate hike
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve officials expressed concern over persistent inflation and three dissented in favor of a rate hike during their July meeting. Investors are now anticipating potential interest rate increases later this year.

Markets.title: US Treasury to double long-dated debt buybacks to battle surging yields
Markets.summary: The US Treasury is doubling its buyback operations for government debt maturing in ten to thirty years. This action aims to improve market liquidity, ease rising bond yields, and manage borrowing costs following a sharp bond selloff.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices fell for the seventh consecutive session due to rising oil prices and US-Iran tensions. The Nifty dropped to 24,078 and the Sensex declined by 326 points, with analysts identifying 24,000 to 24,050 as a crucial support level.

Markets.title: Estee Lauder bets on fragrances and skincare to deliver strong annual profit
Markets.summary: Estee Lauder projected annual profits that will beat Wall Street estimates, driven by strong sales of luxury fragrances like Tom Ford and Le Labo. The company is relying on high demand from young, affluent consumers and expansion in China and international markets to fuel this growth.

Markets.title: Sebi flags manipulative trades during CAS on Sensex expiry day, fines two entities
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi penalized Copthall Mauritius and Mansi Share and Stock Broking for manipulative trading during the August 13, 2026, Closing Auction Session on Sensex expiry day. The regulator issued an interim order to impound Rs 3.67 crore in alleged wrongful gains from the two entities.

Geo-Political.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli military confirmed its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab and six relatives in Gaza, resulting in their deaths. Israel has now opened a criminal investigation into the incident following the recovery of their bodies.

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister is advocating for a presidential election. Elections in the country have been suspended since martial law was introduced in February 2022.

Geo-Political.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: Israel is accepting bids for a controversial settlement project east of Jerusalem. This construction plan would divide the occupied West Bank into two parts and has faced widespread international condemnation.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has shortened its joint military exercises with the United States. The decision follows President Trump's announcement to curtail these drills due to his favorable relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian man has been arrested in Croatia for allegedly participating in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. He is suspected of being one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the underwater pipelines.

Geo-Political.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
Geo-Political.summary: Ecuadorian intelligence chief Michele Sensi-Contugi and his wife Stephany Hollihan were among seven people killed in a helicopter crash in Kenya. Five Americans also died in the accident.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress building course. This visibility occurred without the use of paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that enables users to create various types of content. The tool also provides creators with methods to share and monetize their digital creations.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. The currency's fate depends on whether inflows from RBI's FCNR deposits enter the market or are absorbed as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated in the August MPC meeting minutes that the central bank requires clear evidence of persistent inflation before adjusting interest rates. The monetary policy committee hinted that it may tighten future policies if high price levels continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company Limited reveals how high-traffic routes, changing private involvement, and FASTag annual passes shape India's toll revenue. These factors together drive the financial models and economics of the country's highway system.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia war, high inflation, a depreciating currency, and weak capital expenditure remain downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: To protect rural incomes and consumption from El Nino and a weak monsoon, the government is accelerating agricultural spending. Spending on farming has more than doubled compared to last year alongside increased fertilizer outlays.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for fiscal year 2027. This projected surplus is driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

India.title: Congress Firm On 2-Stanza Vande Mataram, BJP Terms Party "Muslim League"
India.summary: The Congress Working Committee decided to stick to its 1937 resolution restricting party events to only the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram. In response, the BJP criticized the decision by labeling the Congress party as the "Muslim League."

India.title: Tourists Thrashed, Harassed For 2 Hours Over 8-Year-Old's Shorts At Pune Fort
India.summary: Pune police registered a case against nine people for assaulting and harassing tourists for two hours at Sinhagad Fort on August 16. The attack was sparked by an eight-year-old child's choice of clothing.

India.title: Fake, Expired Medicines Worth Rs 5 Crore Seized Repacking Unit In Bengaluru
India.summary: Bengaluru authorities seized fake and expired medicines worth Rs 5 crore from an illegal repacking facility. The operators bought cheap drugs from other states, put them in new vials, and relabeled them as expensive multinational and imported brands.

India.title: Flyers Face Booking Issues For Some Time After IndiGo Website Hit By Snag
India.summary: IndiGo's website suffered a technical glitch that displayed "no data available" messages to users. Consequently, numerous passengers reported issues and were temporarily unable to book flights on the platform.

India.title: Rs 20 Lakh, Chinese Stocks Bet: Money Trail Revealed In Twisha Sharma's Death
India.summary: Twisha Sharma held equity investments worth about Rs 20 lakh in her demat account. Accused Samarth Singh and his mother Giribala Singh allegedly pressured her to transfer these funds after discovering the assets.

India.title: How Pak-Backed Handler Shahzad Bhatti Built Online Terror Network
India.summary: An analysis of social media reveals how Pakistan-backed handler Shahzad Bhatti constructed a vast online network. The investigation details how Bhatti uses this digital infrastructure to lure young Indians into terrorist activities.

General.title: Couple and teenage daughter who died in water off Shoreham named by police
General.summary: A London couple and their teenage daughter died after going into the sea for a swim off the coast of Shoreham. Police have formally named the family following the fatal incident.

General.title: Track defect found on approach to site of Lewes derailment, initial report says
General.summary: An initial RAIB investigation report revealed a track defect near the site of the Lewes derailment. Investigators are currently examining this irregularity as part of their inquiry.

General.title: Thunderstorm warnings issued for parts of UK with flash flooding expected
General.summary: Thunderstorm warnings have been issued for northern England, eastern Scotland, and Northern Ireland starting Wednesday. Flash flooding is expected in these affected regions.

General.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
General.summary: Israel has confirmed its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza, resulting in her death along with six relatives. The military has subsequently opened a criminal investigation into the incident.

General.title: Salmonella outbreak: What we know so far
General.summary: Hundreds have fallen ill with salmonella infections in an outbreak linked to imported eggs.

General.title: Vaccine breakthrough stops cancer returning in trial
General.summary: A new vaccine trial successfully extended the period that patients remained cancer-free. However, researchers have not yet determined how long the protective effects will last.
